Daily Devotional

November 23

17 No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the LORD, and their righteousness is of me, saith the LORD. (Isaiah 54:17 KJV)

This applies to us Christians, and no weapon that comes against us shall succeed. This is a wonderful promise, and it shows that God is going to protect His children. He has given us the tools to fight the devil with, and if we will arm ourselves with the Word, be submitted to God, and realize that we have been given dominion over the devil, we can be successful in fighting him (James 4:7). We have to actively fight against him to be able to stay safe in this world, because the devil only comes to steal, kill, and destroy us (John 10:10). It should be noted that the weapons of the devil are words and thoughts. He is not a powerful enemy, but his way of destroying us is to get us to hear and believe the many words of death that this world speaks every day. The devil loves to put an evil thought in your mind, and then make you feel condemned for having thought it. Control the words you hear, and the thoughts you have, be submitted to God, and you will have the devil under control – Praise God!

Notice that we are to condemn every tongue that comes against us. This means that every word we hear that speaks death, we need to rebuke it, and keep it from having any effect on us. If you don’t rebuke the words that come against you, they will cause you harm. Most people don’t place much value on the words we say and hear, but the bible tells us that every word we speak, and every word we hear, releases either life or death in us (Proverbs 18:21). If you want to walk a victorious life, you must not speak words of death, and don’t say anything that you don’t want to happen. This world speaks death through television and radio all the time, and we must be careful not to listen to words that we would not want to have come true in our lives. The only words that will bring life to us are the Words of the bible, as they are life and spirit. If we can just think, read and hear words of life, then we will live the life that God wants us to live. Thank you Lord for your Word!

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
